import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Load source
    df = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()
    
    # Sort by meter_id ASC, read_ts ASC, read_seq ASC
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"],
        ascending=[True, True, True],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Dedup: keep LAST row per meter_id
    # groupby().tail(1) keeps the last row in each group after sorting
    df = df.groupby("meter_id", dropFalse).tail(1)
    
    # Aggregate: group by zone, sum kwh, count rows
    # dropFalse preserves NULL zone as a real group
    result = df.groupby("zone", dropFalse, as_index=False).agg(
        total_kwh=("kwh", "sum"),
        meter_count=("meter_id", "count")
    )
    
    # Ensure column order matches expected output
    result = result[["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]]
    
    return {"zone_totals": result}
